instructions: These fixtures are prospective compiler acceptance targets, not currently passing executable tests. Match expected diagnostics semantically, not by exact text. Backend case SCL-034 remains reject until native feature readiness; others target eventual Java/LLVM parity.

cases.description: plain classes remain extensible
cases.source:
define class Base as end
define class Child extends Base as end

cases.description: final class without superclass
cases.source: define final class Leaf as end

cases.description: sealed with final child
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Leaf as end
define final class Leaf extends Root as end

cases.description: sealed with non-sealed child and open grandchild
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Open as end
define non-sealed class Open extends Root as end
define class FutureChild extends Open as end

cases.description: recursively sealed hierarchy
cases.source:
define abstract sealed class Root permits Middle as end
define abstract sealed class Middle extends Root permits Leaf as end
define final class Leaf extends Middle as end

cases.description: abstract non-sealed child
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Open as end
define abstract non-sealed class Open extends Root as end
define class Child extends Open as end

cases.description: cannot extend final
cases.source:
define final class Closed as end
define class Intruder extends Closed as end

cases.description: sealed direct subclass must appear in permits
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Allowed as end
define final class Allowed extends Root as end
define final class Intruder extends Root as end

cases.description: listed child must actually extend the sealed parent
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Unrelated as end
define final class Unrelated as end

cases.description: permits must resolve
cases.source: define sealed class Root permits Missing as end

cases.description: duplicate permitted subclass
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Leaf, Leaf as end
define final class Leaf extends Root as end

cases.description: sealed parent cannot list itself
cases.source: define sealed class Root permits Root as end

cases.description: indirect descendants are not direct permits
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Branch, Leaf as end
define non-sealed class Branch extends Root as end
define final class Leaf extends Branch as end

cases.description: unclassified child of sealed must choose class policy
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Child as end
define class Child extends Root as end

cases.description: non-sealed only directly under sealed
cases.source:
define class Root as end
define non-sealed class Child extends Root as end

cases.description: sealed and final are mutually exclusive
cases.source:
define sealed final class C permits D as end
define final class D extends C as end

cases.description: sealed and non-sealed are mutually exclusive
cases.source:
define sealed non-sealed class C permits D as end
define final class D extends C as end

cases.description: abstract and final are mutually exclusive
cases.source: define abstract final class C as end

cases.description: sealed requires explicit nonempty permits
cases.source: define sealed class Root as end

cases.description: unhyphenated nonsealed is not canonical
cases.source: define nonsealed class Child as end

cases.description: single sealed parent with inheritance cycle
cases.source:
define sealed class A permits B as end
define sealed class B extends A permits A as end

cases.description: simple alias cannot forge authorized nominal subclass
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Leaf as end
define class Other extends Root as end
define type Leaf = Other

cases.description: permits declaration with no sealed modifier
cases.source:
define class Root permits Leaf as end
define final class Leaf extends Root as end

cases.description: non-sealed cannot have permits clause
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Child as end
define non-sealed class Child extends Root permits Grandchild as end
define class Grandchild extends Child as end

cases.description: final class cannot declare permits
cases.source:
define final class Root permits Child as end
define class Child extends Root as end

cases.description: unrelated final field modifier stays independent
external undeclared subclass cannot bypass permits via import
cases.source: // Two-module integration fixture: importing a nominal sealed parent must not allow a new unlisted descendant.

cases.description: stale module generation with changed permits fingerprint fails
cases.source: // Two-generation integration fixture: a stale permitted-subclasses ABI is rejected before execution.

cases.description: host-crafted class descriptor cannot bypass final/sealed policy
cases.source: // Runtime-admission fixture: forged or name-only guest class ancestry cannot bypass compiler identity.

cases.description: closed final descendants can prove total type coverage
cases.source: // Match fixture: return match closedShape over FinalA / FinalB; no fallback when closure is proven.

cases.description: non-sealed descendant keeps match coverage open
cases.source: // Match fixture: return match shape over known concrete descendants only; require covering branch or wildcard.

cases.description: guarded arm does not prove class coverage
cases.source: // Match fixture: guarded subtype pattern without unguarded coverage cannot prove totality.

cases.description: sealed actor hierarchy not silently conflated with sealed class support
cases.source: define sealed actor Worker permits Child as end

cases.description: LLVM fail-closed until native hierarchical class lowering
cases.source:
define sealed class Root permits Leaf as end
define final class Leaf extends Root as end
